successCriteria.description: Each of the five flagged import statements in web/src/modules/auth/auth-context.tsx, auth.service.ts, and auth.service.test.ts resolves to web/src/infrastructure/api/index.ts — the api-client module's declared public entry point — and no source edit is required to satisfy the dependency-direction gate.

The committed Web Frontend dependency map (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and .gestalt/architecture/reconciled.json) contains the edge `auth -> api-client`, confirming the flagged imports are a permitted dependency and the findings are false positives.

constraints: No source change is required: the five findings are false positives caused by matching the directory name `infrastructure` against the backend auth module's dependency map instead of the Web Frontend map. The implementation must not introduce a new barrel, re-export, or import path to "fix" a violation that does not exist.

The auth module may depend only on `api-client` and `shared-types` per the committed Web Frontend dependency map; any import reaching into `web/src/infrastructure/` must resolve through `web/src/infrastructure/api/index.ts` (the api-client public entry point), never a deep file path.
outOfScope: Any source edit to auth-context.tsx, auth.service.ts, or auth.service.test.ts — the findings are false positives and no code change is warranted.
Introducing a `web/src/infrastructure/index.ts` barrel or relocating the api-client module — the existing `web/src/infrastructure/api/index.ts` is already the declared public entry point.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The module named `api-client` is declared with path `web/src/infrastructure/api/` and the dependency_map contains `{"from_":"auth","to":"api-client"}`; the flagged imports must match this committed edge, not the backend auth map.
The Web Frontend dependency map (line ~793) states `auth → api-client, shared-types` and defines `api-client` as `web/src/infrastructure/api/`; the flagged imports are exactly this permitted edge.

The api-client public entry point re-exports `ApiClient`, `IApiClient`, `ApiError`, `TokenStorage`, and `ITokenStorage`; the flagged imports (`IApiClient`, `ITokenStorage`, `ApiError`, `TokenStorage`) must resolve to these exact exports.
